Here are 5 common routinary activities classified as passive or active:

| Activities | Passive/Active |
|------------|-----------------|
| 1. Watching TV | Passive |
| 2. Walking to work/school | Active |
| 3. Reading a book | Passive |
| 4. Exercising/working out | Active |
| 5. Cooking meals | Active |

Note: The classification of activities as passive or active generally depends on the level of physical engagement required:
- Passive activities typically involve minimal physical movement and are more mentally focused
- Active activities require physical movement and energy expenditure
